project.name: Worth Milestone 7.5 Coplanar Overlap Region Extraction

phases.title: Readiness-Bound Overlap-Region Request Boundary
acceptance: the only 7.5 request path consumes TouchedGraphParityReadinessInput through TopologyMilestoneSevenFiveOverlapReadinessConsumer plus a matching PlanarBooleanLoopReconstructionLedgerReceipt
a PlanarBooleanOverlapReadinessLoopLedgerBinding carries selected-route, touched-closure, overlap identity, Query posture, residue, source-firewall, architecture-claim, and loop-ledger provenance
loop-ledger-only, local-readiness, copied-digest, and raw-loop request construction paths are denied before overlap participation begins
phases.instructions: Start by rereading all coding guidelines, the updated 7.5 spec, the touched-graph roadmap, Milestone 16 readiness handoff surfaces, Forge Query AI_README, and the 7.4 loop-ledger APIs. Implement Phase 1 as a parallel request-boundary lane, not an in-place loop-reconstruction refactor.
phases.qa_focus: No loop-ledger-only entry, no local readiness vocabulary, no selected-route rediscovery, and no request constructor that accepts copied fields.

phases.title: Overlap Extraction Surface Contract And Registration
acceptance: the parallel planar_boolean_overlap_region_extraction folder skeleton exists before displaced-surface surgery
every new 7.5 artifact has one owning folder and one consuming phase
the operator classification matrix and validator registration plan reject unnamed helpers and local readiness clones
phases.instructions: Freeze the parallel folder cutover map, operator classification matrix, and validator registration plan before implementing overlap algorithms.
phases.qa_focus: No in-place 7.4 refactor, no helper sprawl, no unclassified operator, and no validator plan deferred to closeout.

phases.title: Loop Participation And Overlap Lineage Recovery
acceptance: loop, island, and overlap-chain participation are recovered only from the readiness-bound request and real 7.4 ledger products
participation rows preserve loop role, island origin, overlap-chain lineage, and persistent-name inputs
dangling, contradictory, foreign, or rediscovered participation denies before adjacency construction
phases.instructions: Recover the loop, island, and overlap-chain lineage that overlap extraction is allowed to consume without rewalking raw split or continuation surfaces.
phases.qa_focus: No anonymous region candidates, no split-fragment rewalk, and no participation recovery used to repair missing readiness proof.

phases.title: Overlap Adjacency Index And Canonical Ordering
acceptance: overlap neighborhoods are represented by a first-class adjacency index product
canonical ordering basis is stable across replay and benign input-order variation
production overlap extraction rejects unindexed discovery and incidental iteration-order tie breaks
phases.instructions: Build the overlap adjacency index and canonical ordering basis as a proof boundary, not as a hidden performance optimization.
phases.qa_focus: No repeated pairwise loop scans in the production-confidence path and no map-order-derived adjacency truth.

phases.title: Coplanar Arrangement Graph Construction
acceptance: participating overlap neighborhoods lower into a concrete coplanar arrangement graph
arrangement cell set is stable and traceable to the adjacency index and ordering basis
shared-area claims cannot be admitted without concrete cell substrate
phases.instructions: Build the canonical planar subdivision that turns overlap neighborhoods into area-bearing cells.
phases.qa_focus: No yes/no shared-area gates without cells and no arrangement graph that reopens raw loop discovery.

phases.title: Overlap Cell Containment And Operand Winding Field
acceptance: each arrangement cell carries operand containment and operand-local winding evidence
cell classification is deterministic under replay and benign ordering variation
shared-area admission cannot run without explicit containment and winding evidence
phases.instructions: Classify arrangement cells by operand containment and operand-local winding so later phases can distinguish inside-both truth from mere coincidence.
phases.qa_focus: No premature 7.6 classification, no shared-area admission without cell evidence, and no canonical-winding substitute for operand-local winding truth.

phases.title: Overlap Island Extraction And Component Partition
acceptance: arrangement cells, containment, and winding products lower into overlap islands and component partitions
boundary-contact components and area-overlap components remain separable before outcome classification
contradictory component membership or mixed islands that cannot be partitioned deny before boundary-only or area outcomes are emitted
phases.instructions: Aggregate arrangement cells and contact structure into overlap islands and typed component partitions without yet deciding final region admission.
phases.qa_focus: No island flattening, no mixed-component collapse, and no boundary-only island fact before component proof.

phases.title: Boundary Contact Component Classification
acceptance: shared-boundary and pure-boundary-only outcomes are typed separately from area outcomes
boundary-only contact cannot be promoted into positive-area overlap
mixed islands cannot be hidden by emitting only pure-boundary outcomes
phases.instructions: Classify pure boundary-contact components and keep them structurally separate from islands that still carry positive-area overlap components.
phases.qa_focus: No area honesty theater, no generic overlap-failed bucket, and no mixed island flattened into pure boundary contact.

phases.title: Shared-Area Cell Admission And Mixed-Island Denial Boundary
acceptance: shared-area and mixed-boundary-area outcomes are typed separately
positive-area admission consumes area components, containment, winding, and pure-boundary outcomes
mixed or contradictory islands deny before admitted overlap regions are produced
phases.instructions: Admit positive-area overlap components and deny mixed or contradictory islands that still require more than the milestone admits.
phases.qa_focus: No area admission from coincident-neighborhood rhetoric and no mixed island admitted before component-level proof.

phases.title: Pre-Region Coincidence And Orientation Normalization
acceptance: opposite-sense overlap normalization has a typed product before region promotion
canonical winding basis is stable across replay and reversed source-edge sense
unstable or ambiguous winding tie breakers deny with localized reasons
phases.instructions: Normalize opposite-sense coincidence and pre-region orientation before candidate promotion.
phases.qa_focus: No incidental ordering, no source-edge-sense drift, and no hidden winding correction inside region candidates.

phases.title: Overlap-Region Candidate Promotion And Product Boundary
acceptance: positive-area candidates promote through an explicit candidate set and denial set
boundary-only outcomes remain products but do not masquerade as admitted regions
candidate promotion consumes area and winding products without reopening arrangement discovery
phases.instructions: Promote admitted overlap-region candidates through a clear product boundary while keeping boundary-only outcomes separate.
phases.qa_focus: No boundary-only region promotion and no broad candidate builder that recomputes prior phases.

phases.title: Post-Admission Canonical Winding And Boundary Normalization
acceptance: admitted regions receive canonical winding and boundary normalization products
normalization is replay-stable under benign loop-order variation
normalization failures deny before identity and ledger assembly
phases.instructions: Finalize canonical winding and boundary normalization for admitted regions after candidate promotion.
phases.qa_focus: No post-hoc ledger cleanup and no normalization that mutates earlier proof products in place.

phases.title: Overlap-Region Identity, Persistent Naming, And Lineage Propagation
acceptance: admitted regions receive stable identity derived from readiness-bound request, loop ledger, area, winding, and lineage inputs
persistent-name propagation and subshape-signature maps are typed products
conflicting name propagation denies before decision-log assembly
phases.instructions: Mint overlap-region identity and propagate persistent names without claiming final face-level naming authority.
phases.qa_focus: No fixture-only IDs, no final face naming semantics, and no name propagation hidden in ledger rows.

phases.title: Overlap Decision Log And Overlap Ledger Assembly
acceptance: one decision log records every request, participation, adjacency, arrangement, contact, area, winding, identity, and boundary-only decision
one PlanarBooleanOverlapRegionLedgerReceipt is the exclusive overlap-truth boundary for 7.6+
ledger assembly rejects missing prior proof products and synthetic overlap rows
phases.instructions: Assemble the canonical overlap decision log, ledger, and receipt from prior phase products only.
phases.qa_focus: No direct ledger construction in tests and no receipt that omits readiness-bound request identity.

phases.title: Evidence, Replay, Determinism, And Anti-Theatre Fences
acceptance: overlap extraction has typed workload evidence, stage requirement, replay parity, checkpoint parity, public-contract fence, and anti-theatre proof
evidence proves the readiness handoff, readiness consumer, readiness-to-loop binding, and overlap ledger all participated
synthetic readiness, raw loops, copied overlap rows, and bypassed arrangement or cell proof fail public-contract or compile-fail checks
phases.instructions: Make overlap extraction a real workload stage and prove replay, checkpoint, determinism, and anti-theatre fences before closeout.
phases.qa_focus: No evidence that proves only execution, no synthetic overlap rows, and no replay path that reopens raw loops or readiness proof.

phases.title: Summum Bonum Closeout Certification
acceptance: planar_boolean_overlap_region_metaboss_is_canonical_replayable_area_honest_and_unforgeable covers every named hostile subcase
closeout proves one readiness-bound overlap ledger or typed localized denial across replay, ordering, opposite-sense, nested, mixed, and overlap-storm pressure
7.6 can consume PlanarBooleanOverlapRegionLedgerReceipt without reopening touched graph, selected route, Query posture, loops, islands, cells, or scans
phases.instructions: Run the hostile closeout program and do not close the milestone until the readiness-bound overlap-region authority is genuinely unforgeable.
phases.qa_focus: No completion by vibes, no hidden raw-loop questions, and no closeout that bypasses the unified touched-graph architecture.
